NEW
10 IF 1<2 PRINT "LT PASS"
20 IF 2>1 PRINT "GT PASS"
30 IF 1<=1 PRINT "LE PASS"
40 IF 2>=2 PRINT "GE PASS"
50 IF 1 LT 2 PRINT "LT WORD PASS"
60 IF 2 GT 1 PRINT "GT WORD PASS"
70 IF 1 LE 1 PRINT "LE WORD PASS"
80 IF 2 GE 2 PRINT "GE WORD PASS"
90 IF 2<1 THEN 900
100 IF 1>2 THEN 900
110 IF 2<=1 THEN 900
120 IF 1>=2 THEN 900
130 COLOR 2;TC. 31
140 PRINT "COMPARE PASS"
150 STOP
900 COLOR 1;TC. 31
910 PRINT "COMPARE FAIL"
920 STOP
RUN
